change: For dense graphs with disproportionate historical indices, track successful grouping partners with a bounded bitset (at most 8 KiB). Existing dense short-index path and sparse borrowed maps remain. Empty names return early. Pair order, first successful partner, thresholds, text, schema and cadence preserved.

fixture.scope: Compare immediately preceding indexed/borrowed helper with bounded-bitset candidate in the same release test binary. Four 500-entity shapes: dense/sparse with short/maximal historical indices. 100 operations per dense-high-index child, 500 otherwise. Common setup validates both against original legacy output; not app-wide savings
fixture.memory_scope: macOS wait4 maximum process RSS includes fixture setup and the common legacy/candidate validation before timing, so it cannot isolate memory savings from the changed helper

validation.oracles: Original algorithm plus immediately preceding helper; dense/sparse short/maximal indices, multiple pair orders, threshold edges, duplicate/missing names, Unicode/NUL, self-pairs and empty names.

app_comparison.scope: Production app comparison required. Dense-high-index fixture savings do not establish this branch is active in current idle app workloads or establish app-wide CPU, physical footprint or wakeup savings.

build_axis.regression: All 13 build-pipeline tests passed. Real wrapper preserves both fake-Cargo children CPU and runtime/generator failures; regression fails against retained original wrapper specifically for missing CPU.

native_thread_probe.limits: Small real Swift package only. Native backend is deprecated by installed SwiftPM. No default backend, app compiler cap or app build performance change retained; full app build/test/package compatibility requires validation.

limits: Dense-high-index process CPU falls 90.6%; unchanged short dense path observes -2.8%, sparse +6.3%, sparse high index +3.0%. Sparse regressions remain visible; no broad helper or app-wide gain claimed.
Maximum process RSS includes common setup/oracle checks; dense-high-index mean rises 11.04 to 11.25 MiB. No helper memory saving established.

production_package.rss_note: 1s aggregate process-tree RSS samples; shared pages may be counted twice; short peaks may be missed
production_package.scope: Absolute production packaging cost using existing compiler caches, two package jobs and ad-hoc signing; no notarization or stapling. Not a comparative build result.
